label: HP EliteDesk 800 G9 small form factor
description: Small-form-factor business desktop, 12th-gen Core, one 1GbE RJ45 plus USB-C and DisplayPort.
notes: 1GbE (Intel I219-LM) RJ45 on the rear, standard across 800 G9 SFF SKUs. Wi-Fi 6E is an optional M.2 module; base builds are wired-only, so no wlan0 is modelled.
